cases.question: Tampilkan tren Net Revenue bulanan selama 12 bulan terakhir

baseline.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', fo.order_date) AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(fo.gross_amount - fo.discount_amount + fo.shipping_cost) AS net_revenue FROM gold.fact_orders fo WHERE fo.order_date >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND fo.order_date <= DATE '2026-11-24' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC
baseline.note: Included cancelled/refunded orders and shipping cost in monthly Net Revenue. (Value mismatch on net_revenue for ('2025-12-01',): expected 4647738000.0, got 6159897100.0.)

aegistic.sql:
SELECT
  dd.month_start AS order_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fo.order_status = 'completed' THEN fo.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue
FROM gold.fact_orders AS fo
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_date AS dd
  ON fo.order_date = dd.date_day
WHERE
  fo.order_status = 'completed'
  AND dd.date_day BETWEEN CAST('2025-12-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-11-24' AS DATE)
GROUP BY
  dd.month_start
ORDER BY
  order_date ASC
LIMIT 100
aegistic.note: Matched ground truth across 12 row(s) (max diff 0.0000%).

cases.question: Berapa Gross Margin (%) per kategori produk?

baseline.sql: SELECT dp.category_name AS product_category, SUM(foi.item_net_amount - (foi.quantity * foi.unit_cost)) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(foi.item_net_amount), 0) AS gross_margin_pct FROM gold.fact_order_items foi INNER JOIN gold.fact_orders fo ON foi.order_id = fo.order_id LEFT JOIN gold.dim_products dp ON foi.product_id = dp.product_id WHERE fo.order_status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
baseline.note: Matched item-level gross margin calculation on completed orders.

aegistic.sql:
SELECT
  dp.category_name AS product_category,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN fo.order_status = 'completed'
      THEN foi.item_net_amount - (
        foi.quantity * foi.unit_cost
      )
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) * 1.0 / NULLIF(
    SUM(CASE WHEN fo.order_status = 'completed' THEN foi.item_net_amount ELSE 0 END),
    0
  ) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM gold.fact_order_items AS foi
INNER JOIN gold.fact_orders AS fo
  ON foi.order_id = fo.order_id
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_products AS dp
  ON foi.product_id = dp.product_id
WHERE
  fo.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY
  dp.category_name
ORDER BY
  gross_margin_pct DESC
LIMIT 100
aegistic.note: Matched ground truth across 6 row(s) (max diff 0.0000%).

cases.question: Tampilkan Repeat Purchase Rate per segmen pelanggan

baseline.sql: WITH cust_orders AS (SELECT dc.customer_segment, fo.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM gold.fact_orders fo LEFT JOIN gold.dim_customers dc ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT customer_segment, COUNT(CASE WHEN cnt > 1 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS repeat_purchase_rate FROM cust_orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
baseline.note: Counted cancelled and refunded orders as repeat purchases when computing Repeat Purchase Rate. (Value mismatch on repeat_purchase_rate for ('enterprise',): expected 0.8158890290037831, got 0.7785800240673887.)

aegistic.sql:
SELECT
  dc.customer_segment AS customer_segment,
  COUNT(
    DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN fo.order_status = 'completed' AND fo.order_rank > 1
      THEN fo.customer_id
    END
  ) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fo.order_status = 'completed' THEN fo.customer_id END), 0) AS repeat_purchase_rate
FROM gold.fact_orders AS fo
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_customers AS dc
  ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id
WHERE
  fo.order_status = 'completed'
GROUP BY
  dc.customer_segment
ORDER BY
  repeat_purchase_rate DESC
LIMIT 100
aegistic.note: Matched ground truth across 4 row(s) (max diff 0.0000%).

baseline.note: Applied global WHERE order_status = 'completed', causing Refund Rate to evaluate to 0%. (Value mismatch on refund_rate for ('jabodetabek',): expected 0.22254960914010824, got 0.0.)

aegistic.sql:
SELECT
  dc.region AS region,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fo.order_status = 'completed' THEN fo.order_id END) AS total_orders,
  COUNT(
    DISTINCT CASE WHEN fo.order_status IN ('refunded', 'cancelled') THEN fo.order_id END
  ) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT fo.order_id), 0) AS refund_rate
FROM gold.fact_orders AS fo
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_customers AS dc
  ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id
GROUP BY
  dc.region
ORDER BY
  total_orders DESC
LIMIT 100

cases.question: Show monthly Net Revenue and Completed Orders for Jabodetabek in 2026

baseline.sql: SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST(ro.order_date AS DATE)) AS DATE) AS order_date, SUM(ro.gross_amount - ro.discount_amount) AS net_revenue, COUNT(ro.order_id) AS total_orders FROM bronze.raw_orders ro LEFT JOIN bronze.raw_customers rc ON ro.customer_id = rc.customer_id WHERE rc.region = 'Jabodetabek' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(ro.order_date AS DATE)) = 2026 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 ASC
baseline.note: Queried uncleaned bronze.raw_orders with duplicates, NULL dates, and non-completed orders. (Value mismatch on net_revenue for ('2026-01-01',): expected 1258417600.0, got 1667384400.0.)

aegistic.sql:
SELECT
  dd.month_start AS order_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fo.order_status = 'completed' THEN fo.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS net_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fo.order_status = 'completed' THEN fo.order_id END) AS total_orders
FROM gold.fact_orders AS fo
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_customers AS dc
  ON fo.customer_id = dc.customer_id
LEFT JOIN gold.dim_date AS dd
  ON fo.order_date = dd.date_day
WHERE
  fo.order_status = 'completed'
  AND dd.date_day BETWEEN CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND CAST('2026-11-24' AS DATE)
  AND dc.region = 'Jabodetabek'
GROUP BY
  dd.month_start
ORDER BY
  order_date ASC
LIMIT 100
